rule: Tower server code is NOT modified; ambiguities become versioned contract delta requests with evidence; no client-side bypass (mission sections 12/1)

ambiguities.prior_evidence: the previous executor recorded an 8-digit 'Tower numeric-code shape'
ambiguities.request: Tower confirms the canonical length; a mismatch becomes a versioned contract delta, not a silent client change

ambiguities.evidence_class: typed hypothesis (request bodies are NOT visible in the dex string pool)
ambiguities.request: Tower confirms; simulator fixtures pin whichever shape is confirmed

ambiguities.android_implementation: claim_key, challenge, pop_signature, device_public_key_pem, device_key_algorithm, attestation_metadata
ambiguities.evidence_class: pop_signature/device_public_key_pem/device_key_algorithm/attestation_metadata bound from the dex pool; claim_key/challenge bound from PairingFlow signatures
is_pending/get_state/get_pending + console_token/phraseHint bound from dex; exact field casing is hypothesis
ambiguities.request: Tower confirms; the client parser accepts ACKED|ACK|CONFIRMED and phrase_hint|phrase tolerance

ambiguities.prior_evidence: B's QR message says the QR TTL is '2-5 minuti'
ambiguities.request: Tower confirms the challenge (not QR) TTL; 120 s is the client guard until confirmed

ambiguities.android_implementation: the frozen truth is bound as: dex string pool of the byte-exact B APK + CD-A4R-001 (docs/a4r/A4R_TOWER_CONTRACT_DELTA.json)
ambiguities.request: Tower publishes the v1.0.0 contract document or confirms the dex-bound surface as v1.0.0
Owner uploads the Hermes-Tower git bundle / creates the repo so the reconstruction can be diffed against the true source in a later block
